Lehigh Valley Smile Designs — SEO Audit

Seven clear findings, with evidence and fixes.

Read-only · 28 September 2026 · 59 sitemap pages checked · live Google profile verified

Finish the location pageMake mobile loading stableUse one set of hoursFix repeated service schemaCorrect the aligner messageAnswer treatment questionsExplain the smile casesMeasure the next stepsFix order
01

Finish the location page

The public Areas Served page has no title, normal navigation or contact path, leaving visitors on an unfinished page.

  • Restore a complete page template, metadata and useful service/contact links.
  • If it is not needed, retire it deliberately and remove it from the sitemap.
02

Make mobile loading stable

The homepage mobile lab test scored 35/100, with slow main content and large layout shifts that can make the page harder to use.

  • Trace the actual slow asset, shifting elements and heavy scripts, then fix those causes.
  • Retest after changes and check real-user data separately.
03

Use one set of hours

The homepage shows different Monday and Friday opening times from Google, while Saturday wording conflicts across the site and profile.

  • Use Google's weekday reference: Monday 9:00 AM and Friday 9:30 AM.
  • Ask the client whether Saturdays are weekly or first/third only before changing that schedule.
04

Fix repeated service schema

All 34 service pages reuse offer and review markup with nonnumeric prices and the same testimonial, so the data does not accurately describe each treatment.

  • Remove the inaccurate product/offer/review template and keep truthful Dentist and Service data.
  • Validate any genuine remaining offers and ratings against their visible content.
05

Correct the aligner message

“Straighten while You sleep” can imply nighttime-only Invisalign wear, while the service page does not explain the daily wear requirement.

  • Replace the heading with a clear, clinician-approved message.
  • Add approved wear-time, suitability and retainer guidance to the Invisalign page.
06

Answer treatment questions

Core service pages explain benefits but give limited help with suitability, risks, costs and the clinician who will provide care.

  • Add practical, clinician-reviewed answers for implants, Invisalign, sleep apnea and emergency care.
  • Link relevant costs, financing, clinician bios and real cases.
07

Explain the smile cases

The gallery has 15 numbered cases but does not say what treatment was done, who provided it or which service the visitor should explore.

  • Add approved, anonymous treatment descriptions and realistic timelines.
  • Link cases to their services and keep the individual-results disclaimer.

Measure the next steps

This public audit cannot confirm Google indexation, actual traffic, real-user performance or the full Google profile settings.

  • Use approved Search Console, Analytics and GBP access to measure changes.

Fix order

Fix the verified technical and information problems before expanding content.

  • First: location template, mobile loading, hours and schema.
  • Next: clinical wording, service answers and case links.
